title: Individual HF constituent orbits convert collective support into a fixed-model exponential state-size barrier

statement.quantifiers: Fixed parameter-free binary2D FO+Hartig interpretation program with quotient closures, given uniform collective cofilling and imported base equivalence/homogeneity on opposite-answer inputs N=Theta(n).
statement.assertion: Every successful program needs max universe size S>r^((r−1)t/(2 kappa r)); t is linear in n for fixed program width. Arbitrarily long finite runtime is allowed; input size is included.
assumptions: Collective union-support cofilling modulo gradients with coefficient-uniform constants.
Exact HF tuple-support transfer on all finite ranks and complete base-type homogeneity.
Counting quotient VALUES with equal orbit fibres, not counting molecule representations.

inputs: Actual fixed program width and correct source expansion/base/HF contracts.
outputs: Model-specific maximum-state-size lower bound, not unrestricted PTIME/CPT/DeepWL resource lower bound.
interface.precision: Exact quantifiers; no bounded-HF-rank or runtime-length substitution.
costs: Growing program width must be charged.
Finite unrolling may have huge formula length; fixed variable width is the relevant invariant.
Published source premises not all independently reconstructed.

proof_mechanism: Joint central annihilator and averaged face activity bound support by kappa r/(r−1) times log_r orbit.
Recursive quotient state codes give each constituent orbit at most S², independently of run length.
For fixed width, s<=t lets HF transfer identify every halted output on opposite-answer inputs.
Contradiction gives the exponential bound; one cannot replace the individual orbit bound by a total-trace size bound.
obstructions: Scalar cofilling yields only a quadratic support estimate.
Characteristic-two lifts require quadratic-map preservation; commutator preservation alone fails.
Qualitative polynomial equivalence of models does not transfer arbitrary-resource exponential bounds.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Acquire coefficient-uniform support, exact full-rank HF encoding and a width-preserving interpreter; state the charged resource being bounded.

review.source_reported: Source separate internal reconstructions and scoped exact checks reported; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
